title: Integer-Output RS Decoder HDL Optimized
source_docs: Communications Toolbox HDL Support/Error Detection and Correction/Block/Integer_Output_RS_Decoder_HDL_Optimized.md
text: Decode data using Reed-Solomon (RS) decoder, 4 inputs, 6 outputs; {Codeword length} sets the length of codeword, {Message length} sets the length of message, {Source of primitive polynomial} sets the primitive polynomial source, {Primitive polynomial}, {Source of B, the starting power for roots of the primitive polynomial} sets the source of starting power for roots of primitive, {B value} sets the starting exponent of roots and {Output number of corrected symbol errors} sets the number of corrected symbol errors. Values come from the instance.

ports.summary: Start of input frame indicator scalar

ports.summary: End of input frame indicator scalar

ports.name: startOut
ports.summary: Start of output frame indicator scalar

ports.name: endOut
ports.summary: End of output frame indicator scalar

ports.name: errOut
ports.summary: Indications of corruption of received data scalar

ports.summary: Number of corrected errors nonnegative scalar

params.name: Codeword length
params.values: Length of codeword 7 (default) | range from 7 to 65, 535

params.values: Source of starting power for roots of primitive polynomial Auto (default) | Property
